roadmap.step: Study linear algebra and probability, the mathematical backbone of machine learning.
Complete an introductory Python course and run your first data analysis on a real dataset.
Learn descriptive statistics, distributions, and hypothesis testing.
Build a simple end-to-end ML model, such as a price predictor.
Study neural network fundamentals and implement one from scratch.
Apply for a data science or ML internship and contribute to a Kaggle competition.

roadmap.step: Master Class 11-12 biology and chemistry to NEET standard.
Sit at least one NEET mock series and analyse your weak topics.
Practise history-taking and clinical communication with peers or online simulators.
Learn basic biostatistics for reading research papers and evidence-based medicine.
Complete compulsory internship rotations; register with NMC.

sources._note: Representative institution type: government medical college (state or central). Tuition based on MCC/state counselling fee schedules. salary.y1 and y3 reflect government resident/house officer stipend; y5 assumes post-PG independent practice.
sources.tuition_per_year: MCC/state counselling fee schedules for government medical colleges. Page not opened. Estimate: most state govt medical colleges charge Rs 10,000-20,000/yr tuition; Rs 13,000 used as midpoint.
sources.years: MBBS duration per NMC regulations: 4.5 years study + 1 year compulsory rotating internship = 5.5 years. Page not opened.
sources.salary.y1: Government resident stipend post-internship. Page not opened. Estimate: junior resident stipends at govt hospitals approx Rs 50,000-60,000/month; Rs 55,000 used.
sources.salary.y3: ASSUMPTION: same as y1 (Rs 55,000) because y3 falls inside PG residency years for most students. DECISIONS.md Section 3 flat-curve exception for clinical careers.
sources.salary.y5: ASSUMPTION: Rs 120,000/month assuming PG completion and independent practice by year 5-6. DECISIONS.md Section 3 exception.
sources.years_to_first_income: DECISIONS.md Section 7: 5.5 study + 1 yr internship = 6.5; rounded to 7.0 conservatively. Page not opened.
sources.coaching: NEET requires 1-2 years classroom coaching. Rule: DECISIONS.md Section 2. Page not opened.
sources.automation_risk: Relative judgment score per DECISIONS.md Section 4. Not sourced from a published index. Clinical/MBBS anchor 0.10-0.20.
sources.entrance_required: NEET mandatory for all MBBS admissions per NMC rules. Page not opened.

roadmap.step: Strengthen applied mathematics: basic calculus, geometry, and mensuration used in technical drawing.
Build a small hands-on project in the workshop such as a simple electrical circuit or a machined part.
Study your branch subject in depth and complete a lab project that could go on your CV.
Do an industrial training placement (mandatory in most polytechnic programmes) and convert it into a job offer.
